Re: Account reference: ACC-406327

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter dated [not provided] regarding the above-referenced account. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt and a cease and desist from further collection efforts.

We confirm that we are in possession of the account and that the current balance is $33,660.00. The original creditor is Apex Auto Finance, and the account was charged off on August 5, 2021. Your last payment was made on June 22, 2023.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt within 30 days of your request. We will investigate your request and provide you with the necessary documentation.

We will also verify that our records indicate that we have not contacted the incorrect individual. However, we will provide you with a copy of any contract or agreement signed with our company or the original creditor, as required by the FDCPA.

Please note that we will continue to attempt to collect the debt unless and until you dispute the debt in writing and we are required to cease collection efforts.

You have the right to dispute this debt and may request that we verify the debt by providing documentation. If you wish to dispute this debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
